survey: A witch hat on its own, floating on a plain orange spiral background, seen from a three-quarter view from above. The main parts are: (1) a wide, flat, oval brim with an even rounded edge; (2) a tall cone rising from the middle of the brim and bending to the right into a curved point; (3) a purple hatband around the bottom of the cone where it meets the brim; (4) a square gold buckle on the front of the band. The cone joins the brim cleanly all the way round. The band sits flat against the cone and follows its shape. The buckle is a square frame with two vertical bars inside. Floating with no support is normal for an icon card. The brim's oval shape is what a round brim looks like at this angle. The bent tip is the classic witch-hat shape, not a fault.

errors.where: Gold buckle on the front of the purple hatband
errors.what: The buckle cannot work as one. It has two vertical bars inside the frame where a real buckle has one center bar or a prong. The band does not pass through it or come out of it, and no strap end shows. It looks like a flat badge stuck on the band rather than something holding it shut.

fix: Make the square gold buckle have a single vertical center bar. Thread the purple hatband through the buckle frame, with a short strap end coming out of the buckle.
